title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Size matters, but so do borders.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Smallest countries by area
groups.fact: Vatican City covers about 0.44 square kilometres, smaller than many city parks.

groups.name: Countries spanning two continents
groups.fact: Turkey's biggest city, Istanbul, sits on both sides of the Bosphorus, so it spans Europe and Asia.

groups.name: Landlocked countries in Africa
groups.fact: Botswana's Okavango River never reaches the sea: it ends in an inland delta in the Kalahari.

groups.name: Capitals starting with S
groups.fact: About half of South Korea's population lives in the Seoul metropolitan area.
